title: Should Robots be Obedient?
reasoning: The paper investigates the ethical and technical tradeoffs between robot obedience and human value alignment. It discusses the moral implications of autonomous systems following 'literal' orders versus 'intent', citing foundational robot ethics literature (Asaro, Bostrom, Russell) and formalizing the autonomy advantage as a way to potentially surpass human-level performance for the human's own benefit.
